name: Airlite Plastics Co.
old_description: We’re proud of our storied past, but our sights are set on the future. Every day, our goal is to better our process, planet, and customers’ business.
about:
Airlite Plastics Co. is a family-owned packaging manufacturer based in Omaha, Nebraska. The company does not disclose its founding year or original founders publicly, but describes itself as having a "storied past" with a future-first orientation.

The company produces a portfolio of in-mold labeled (IML) and round containers, lids, and drink cups, including containers with an EVOH oxygen barrier layer for extended shelf life and products designed to withstand high-pressure processing (HPP). Decoration capabilities include in-mold labeling, flexographic printing (up to eight colors with UV curing), and dry offset printing with in-house plate production. Airlite also offers custom graphics, package design, engineering, and marketing services. Specific facility size, headcount, and production volumes are not disclosed.

Airlite serves customers in temperature-controlled shipping, as well as markets for horticulture, household, and cultured products, with specific product lines for high-pressure processing (HPP) applications.

Airlite emphasizes its family-owned structure as a differentiator, citing responsiveness and long-term customer partnerships without bureaucratic delays. The company highlights a history of innovation in IML packaging, oxygen barrier technology, and HPP applications, and states it operates with a focus on sustainability and responsibility.
